sources.title: geoBoundaries gbOpen Colombia ADM2
sources.producer_declared_by_source_metadata: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE), Colombia
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as declared in the pinned geoBoundaries metadata
sources.attribution: geoBoundaries, citing DANE as underlying boundary source
sources.canonical_role: The pinned metadata declares ADM2; Colombia's municipal role is supported by the DANE DIVIPOLA/MGN source descriptions. The 2020 row-level table was not obtained, so do not use ADM2 number alone as proof of semantic role.
sources.restoration: Download the pinned media URL, verify uncompressed SHA-256, and gzip with mtime=0 to reproduce the retained packet copy. The raw file is 210,605,856 bytes; the source is too large to retain uncompressed in Git.

sources.title: Pinned geoBoundaries metadata for Colombia ADM2
DIVIPOLA MGN 2024
sources.publisher: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE), Colombia; ArcGIS service item access information names DANE
sources.description: Service item says it represents DIVIPOLA levels under Marco Geoestadístico Nacional (MGN), version 2024.
sources.license: Not stated in the retained ArcGIS item metadata (licenseInfo empty). Public access is stated; this packet does not redistribute service geometry.
sources.access_status: Official ArcGIS item metadata retrieved. Direct REST service query was blocked by the network edge and returned HTML instead of service JSON; no feature rows were read or crosswalked.
sources.restore: Read the ArcGIS item metadata URL, then query the public FeatureServer service and retain the exact layer metadata and rows with their per-layer licensing/attribution.

sources.title: Centros Poblados Divipola 2013I
sources.publisher: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE), Colombia; item access information names DANE
sources.license: Not stated in the retained ArcGIS item metadata (licenseInfo empty). Public access is stated; no feature data are redistributed.
sources.access_status: Official item metadata confirms a DANE settlement point service exists, but the service rows were not retrieved. Its 2013 vintage cannot establish present settlement coverage.
sources.restore: Query the public MapServer layers and retain exact layer metadata, point rows, attribution and per-layer reuse license.

sources.title: Global Self-consistent Hierarchical High-resolution Geography (GSHHG), full-resolution binary release 2.3.7
sources.publisher: Wessel and Smith; University of Hawaiʻi SOEST mirror
sources.license: LGPLv3 or later; license text retained at data/macro-improvements/macro-coverage-oceania/gshhg-LGPL.txt
sources.finding: All 194 pinned source representative points fall inside GSHHG level-1 physical land polygons; one source level-1 polygon centroid falls inside an assigned municipality (Turbo). This is a point screen only, not boundary or completeness proof.
sources.restore: Download the pinned ZIP, verify archive SHA-256, extract full-resolution gshhs_f.b, verify member SHA-256, then run screen_gshhg_colombia.py. Exact matched full source records are retained.

scope_inventory.duplicate_identity_method: Exact original_id plus department parent chain; name-only join is rejected.

limits.settlements: DANE's 2013I Centros Poblados DIVIPOLA point-service metadata was found but its data layers were inaccessible in this run; no authoritative point inventory was compared to the 194 assigned geometries.
limits.islands_and_disconnected_land: Current/source component counts are recorded for all 194; no dated complete island, coastline, hydrography or connected-territory register has yet been cross-matched.
limits.current_dpa: DANE DIVIPOLA MGN 2024 official public item is identified, but service rows could not be retrieved; no 2024 parent/municipality row-level match is claimed.
limits.neighbors: No inter-region shared-edge correction has been established from this tranche; if the current source comparison identifies one, coordinate with #489 and the other region's owner before proposing it.
